use_case_summary: Primary: customer support assistant (chat) with EU-only data residency; latency target 150-250ms p95 for 1–2k concurrent users.
Secondary: document search/semantic retrieval for regulatory docs (embeddings), high recall for reranking pipeline.
Throughput: bursts up to 250 rps for embeddings, sustained 50–80 rps for chat during business hours.
Quality: prefer Llama2-family quantized variants for cost, but legal wants rationale for model choice recorded in audit logs.
network_requirements: Preferred connectivity: AWS PrivateLink endpoints into customer's VPC (no public IPs exposed)
Fallback: VPC peering only if PrivateLink not approved by central networking team
Firewall rules: egress only to specific Redwood control plane IP range; deny all else
Egress controls: all outbound traffic must traverse customer-managed NAT + egress proxy for DLP/log capture
IP allowlists: static list for control plane and health checks; needs weekly update cadence and signed attestations
Mutual TLS: TLS with client certs for control-plane ops and token provisioning
Bastion/Jumpbox: allow SE access for POC via customer-managed bastion with short-lived keys
security_review_notes: Security asks: end-to-end audit logs with log forwarding (syslog/S3) and retention policy configurable to 7 years
KMS: BYOK with HSM support; Redwoods KMS integration must allow key rotation and provide key usage logs
Data residency: enforce EU-only compute and storage with signed attestation; no backups leaving region
SAML/SSO: integrate with customer's Okta; RBAC mapping for AE/SE/CSM roles
Pen test: customer will require pen-test report or option to schedule on-demand pen test after POC
SLA: asking for 99.9% uptime for Dedicated + 100ms additional latency budget for private connectivity overhead
